verdict.rationale: Anrok's own materials say certificates are collected, verified, and stored, and can be uploaded through the UI or the API, so the collection, validation, and storage parts of the story are documented as product capabilities. Expiry tracking and automatic application at calculation time are not evidenced, and the claims are high-level marketing and API snippets. Missing for 10: expiry tracking/renewal alerts, documented automatic application of exemptions at tax calculation, customer-facing collection workflow details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, exemption and resale certificates are managed end to end — collected from customers, validated, stored with expiry tracking, and applied automatically at calculation time

citations.quote: Certificates can be uploaded to Anrok via the Anrok UI as well as via the API.
